shape: Three-portal hub with dense potted-plant obstacles, narrow center (W/S/E gates)
description: Variant of td1: three portals (W/S/E) feeding a central room, but with MORE potted plants constricting the floor down to a single narrow center anchor (5arqhp at the origin). All three portals route through this central pinch point. Several dead-end corner pockets (west, NE, S, SE) hold likely objective spots — each pocket is reachable only via its own backbone anchor.

traversalNotes: DENSE POTTED-PLANT OBSTACLES: the floor is reachable but the plants narrow the safe lanes. STRICT-BACKBONE applies — any edge outside anchorEdges will wedge the player capsule.
All three portals funnel through CENTER (5arqhp). Direct routes:
west ↔ south: spawn_west → nw_inner → north_inner → spawn_south (the north top-bar bypasses center if neither is fenced).
west ↔ east:  spawn_west → nw_inner → center → se_inner → e_inner → spawn_east.
south ↔ east: spawn_south → north_inner → center → se_inner → e_inner → spawn_east.

Four DEAD-END pockets for objective dispatch: w_pocket_n / w_pocket_s (via w_inner), ne_pocket (via north_inner), s_pocket / se_pocket (via south_inner or se_inner). The center should be passed through for cross-pocket transit, never used as a dispatch hub itself (it's the narrowest point — keep walks short there).

Same primitive family as td1 (3-portal hub with plant obstacles); td2 is the dense variant where the center is constricted to a single anchor. Solver should treat as td1 with the dispatch-hub anchor demoted to a transit-only pinch.
